lines.text: Joshua sends two spies from Shittim, and they stay with Rahab, so the king of Jericho demands the men.
Rahab hides the spies among flax on her roof and sends the king's men toward the fords of the Jordan.
Rahab tells the spies that the LORD dried up the Red Sea and that Jericho's hearts melted.
Rahab lets the spies down by a ladder, and they tell her to tie a scarlet cord in the window.
The spies hide in the hill country for seven days, then return and report to Joshua.
